meta.title: Live public cameras
meta.note: Official or explicitly public traffic and road-weather cameras only. Private, login-walled, or unprotected CCTV (Insecam, Shodan-style open cameras) are not included. Stills and short official clips are loaded in the browser on click; some agencies also publish an HLS stream. Windy Webcams was skipped because its API requires a secret key.

tfl.name: TfL JamCams (London)
tfl.license: Open Government Licence (UK). Contains OS data © Crown copyright. Powered by TfL Open Data.
tfl.terms: Attribution required: “Powered by TfL Open Data”. Snapshots and short clips are official TfL traffic cameras. Do not suggest they are private CCTV.

caltrans.name: Caltrans CWWP2 (California DOT)
caltrans.license: Public traffic-camera service from the California Department of Transportation. Attribution: Caltrans.
caltrans.terms: Official highway CCTV provided as a public traveler-information service. Images update on the same URL. Not for identifying people.

fintraffic.name: Fintraffic Digitraffic weather cameras (Finland)
fintraffic.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). Attribution: Fintraffic / Digitraffic.
fintraffic.terms: Official road weather cameras. Image URL is the documented public preset still (weathercam.digitraffic.fi/{presetId}.jpg).

deldot.name: Delaware DOT Traffic Management Center
deldot.license: Public traveler-information service, Delaware Department of Transportation. Attribution: DelDOT.
deldot.terms: Official TMC cameras. This extract keeps live HLS stream links and the public TMC site when a still image is not published.
